standard: ASHRAE Fundamentals 2017 (SI Edition), Chapter 21 Duct Design, Table 1 "Duct Roughness Factors"
source: Transcribed directly from Table 1, p.21.7. Where Table 1 gives a range without a single stated design value, a representative point value was chosen (flagged per-entry below) - the range itself is directly from ASHRAE, only the point-selection within range required engineering judgment. Two entries cross-validated exactly against this same chapter's worked Example 6 (p.21.6): galvanized steel spiral duct (0.12 mm) and flexible duct fully extended (0.9 mm).
